rule: PUBLISHED PUDDLE TILES. ladder[<dominant>__with__<minor>][<10|20|30|40>] = tiles proved, ON THE EXACT BYTES LISTED, to have all four sides of the top diamond pure dominant ground AND a real island of the minor ground inside. Art is at <dir>/post/<file> - read the name, never build it. A tile here composes with any neighbour of its dominant ground without matching anything, which is the whole purpose.

gate.band: the outer 3 erosion rings of the staircase top diamond - measured from the lattice, ring 3 is the first that can never sit beside a neighbour's top face
gate.foreign: a band pixel whose 5x5 mask-limited median sits more than 20.0 dE76 from the tile's OWN trimmed-median background - no dominant-vs-minor classifier is used or needed
gate.island: core_off_frac >= 0.03: a clean rim with no island is a plain top, not a transition tile
gate.measured_on: the published post/ file, never the raw sheet
